chief_complaint: Cough for 1 week following a cold, with thick yellowish-green mucus, chest tightness and soreness, and severe exhaustion.
symptoms: Patient reports a 1-week history of cough following a cold, which started dry and progressed to coughing up thick, yellowish-green mucus. Accompanied by chest tightness, soreness, low-grade fever (99.8°F), and generalized exhaustion. Lower lung fields remain clear on examination.
medications: Guaifenesin (Extended-Release) 600 mg, Ibuprofen 400 mg, Albuterol HFA Inhaler 90 mcg
dosage: 1 tablet Every 12 hours (Q12H); 1 tablet Every 6–8 hours as needed (PRN); 2 puffs Every 4–6 hours as needed (PRN)
advice: Rest up adequately, use a humidifier at home, and drink plenty of water to help thin mucus. Note that while acute symptoms improve in 1 week, a mild cough can linger for 2 to 3 weeks.
follow_up_date: Come back in 10 days if not improving
